definitions: There is always work or trouble for those who are bad or involved in wrongdoing.
People who are constantly busy, often due to their own actions or circumstances, even if those actions are not necessarily 'wicked'.
examples: I've been working all weekend, ain't no rest for the wicked!
After pulling an all-nighter, he muttered, 'Ain't no rest for the wicked.'
lemma: ain't no rest for the wicked
